title: Числа 28 — Numbers 28
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.translation: The LORD said to Moses: “Give the Israelites a command.”
cases.explain: The verb сказать (to say to someone) governs the dative of the addressee → Моисею.

cases.sentence: Приносите одного ___ утром, а другого вечером.
cases.translation: Offer one lamb in the morning and the other at evening.
cases.explain: Ягнёнок is the direct object of приносите; an animate masculine noun takes the genitive-form ending in the accusative → ягнёнка.
The preposition с (with) takes the instrumental → маслом.

cases.sentence: В ___ приносите двух годовалых ягнят без изъяна.
cases.translation: On the Sabbath offer two year-old lambs without defect.
cases.explain: В with a time expression (“on the Sabbath”) takes the accusative → субботу.

cases.sentence: Первый день каждого ___ приносите Господу всесожжение.
cases.translation: On the first day of each month offer the LORD a burnt offering.
cases.explain: Каждого (each) requires the genitive of the noun it modifies → месяца.

cases.translation: …a burnt offering of two young bulls.
cases.explain: The preposition из (of/from) and the numeral phrase двух take the genitive plural → быков.

cases.sentence: Вот огненная ___, которую вы должны совершать Господу.
cases.translation: This is the offering by fire which you must present to the LORD.
cases.explain: Introduced by вот as the subject of the clause, so it stays in the nominative → жертва.

cases.translation: This is the burnt offering ordained at Mount Sinai.
cases.explain: The preposition у (at/near) takes the genitive → горы.

reading.ru: Приносите одного ягненка утром, а другого вечером, вместе с хлебным приношением из одной десятой части ефы лучшей муки, смешанной с четвертью гина оливкового масла.
reading.question: When are the two daily lambs to be offered?
options: One in the morning and the other in the evening
reading.correct: One in the morning and the other in the evening
reading.explain: The text says to offer one lamb in the morning and the other at evening, each with a grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil.

reading.ru: Четырнадцатый день первого месяца — Пасха Господу.
reading.question: What falls on the fourteenth day of the first month?
reading.explain: The verse states that the fourteenth day of the first month is the LORD's Passover.

reading.ru: В пятнадцатый день этого месяца пусть будет праздник, семь дней ешьте пресный хлеб.
reading.question: For how many days are they to eat unleavened bread?
reading.explain: The feast begins on the fifteenth day, and unleavened bread is to be eaten for seven days.

reading.ru: Первый день каждого месяца приносите Господу всесожжение из двух молодых быков, одного барана и семи годовалых ягнят без изъяна.
reading.question: What animals make up the monthly (new moon) burnt offering?
options: Two young bulls, one ram, and seven year-old lambs
reading.correct: Two young bulls, one ram, and seven year-old lambs
reading.explain: The monthly offering consists of two young bulls, one ram, and seven year-old lambs without defect.

reading.ru: В субботу приносите двух годовалых ягнят без изъяна, жертвенными возлияниями при них и хлебным приношением из двух десятых ев и лучшей муки, смешанной с маслом.
reading.question: What is offered on the Sabbath in addition to the regular offering?
reading.explain: On the Sabbath two year-old lambs without defect are offered, with their drink and grain offerings.

reading.ru: Кроме постоянного всесожжения с положенным жертвенным возлиянием, нужно приносить Господу одного козла в жертву за грех.
reading.question: What animal is brought as a sin offering each month?
reading.explain: In addition to the continual burnt offering, one male goat is brought as a sin offering to the LORD.
